sectors.ai: Buy Indonesian tech exposure now: the sector's +2.90% ID rally, led by INET and ELIT, confirms local momentum decoupled from US volatility. Rotate into domestic software and cybersecurity names (INET, ELIT) over US-listed CRM/CRWD, as ID valuations remain 30% cheaper with faster earnings growth. Add on any dip below +1.5% intraday; target 15% overweight for Q3.
